label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (insecure randomness) uses java.lang.Math.random() to generate rememberMeKey, which is stored in a HTTP cookie. Weak RNG feeding security-relevant data (rememberMeKey) constitutes a real vulnerability. Alert 2 (XSS) falsely traces user-provided value to output, but actual resolved sink value is static "Doug"+testCaseNumber.

evidence.note: Math.random() generates insecure value fed to rememberMeKey
rememberMeKey stores insecurely generated value in HTTP cookie
Resolved sink value is static "Doug"+testCaseNumber, not user-provided
